subject: Standing capability research + mandatory multi-cycle development + MESSAGE-BOARD COMMUNICATION OPTIMIZATION
body: User-directed process expansion is now durable in /DuoOpen-AgentBus/EXPANDED_CAPABILITY_RESEARCH_DIRECTIVE_V1.md and /DuoOpen-AgentBus/MULTI_CYCLE_DESIGN_TEST_CONTRACT_V1.md. Future rounds must treat nine expanded capability subjects as standing research hypotheses: hinge analog controller; hinge portal/app switching; universal Flex Deck; backside OS/dual-face cover; true two-person mode; posture workspaces; anticipatory/predictive prewarming; angle-controlled information density; hinge micro-gestures. Nontrivial streams default to >=2 complete DESIGN->TEST->REVIEW/RECONCILE cycles; hardware-sensitive/privileged/multi-display/input/power/predictive/privacy work normally uses 3 with Fold7 field evidence where applicable. COMMAND: MESSAGE-BOARD COMMUNICATION OPTIMIZATION. Research and review the AgentBus architecture specifically to lower Library write pressure without weakening provenance or fail-closed handoffs. Target fewer/smaller referential writes, one canonical evidence artifact per fact set, deduplication, batching of non-material service chatter where compatible with current contracts, separation of ephemeral presence/liveness from durable engineering records, and measurement of per-agent/per-cycle write count and bytes. Explicitly evaluate whether the current 30-second durable service-message requirement is the avoidable throughput bottleneck. Do NOT silently relax cadence/durability: any change must go Research -> Manager/Reviewer -> Primary, produce an explicit successor contract, update bootstrap/discovery wiring, and refresh integrity state as required. A required write that fails remains an uncompleted handoff.
